summary: Stronghold entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Stronghold: Crusader
entries.definitive_edition: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition, with HD/original comparison if exact old balance matters

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Definitive Edition for content; original/HD PC for historical balance

primary.why: Stronghold Crusader now has a current Definitive Edition that remasters the 2002 RTS with new visuals, audio, campaigns, units, AI lords, larger maps, co-op, Steam Workshop, and modern multiplayer. The original/HD version remains important for exact old-balance comparison, but Definitive Edition is the practical current archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition on PC. Record build/date, DLC/update state, campaign/skirmish trail, multiplayer/co-op state, Workshop/mods, and whether the original HD balance was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving original-era balance and behavior.
secondary.why: Definitive Edition adds and changes content, so HD remains the comparison route for the original game state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record build, DLC/update state, Workshop/mods, co-op/multiplayer state, and whether original HD was compared.
